points: \item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B, improving answer reliability and mitigating context errors in document-level QA for agentic AI applications.
\item Built a hybrid retrieval workflow combining dense embeddings and BM25 search, enhancing relevance and coverage of retrieved documents for multi-agent systems and intelligent automation.
\item Developed an LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline to assess faithfulness and relevance across hundreds of QA examples, ensuring production-ready reliability for AI agents across cloud platforms.
\item Introduced batched query extraction, reducing LLM calls by ~80% per query and enabling faster, reliable production inference for domain-specific AI agents and agentic workflows.
\item Built a multi-agent research workflow using CrewAI with A2A communication, enabling collaborative decision-making and task automation for enterprise transformation strategies.
